name: Cathedral of Saint Vincent de Paul, Tunis
scope: The standing Cathedral of Saint Vincent de Paul and Saint Olivia, Tunis. The model includes its polychrome façade, triple porch, rose window, paired tower crowns, crossing dome and rear apse.

stories.title: Cathedral of Saint Vincent de Paul

review.notes: Started with Qualla. The exterior hero carries attribution conditions, the aerial postcard is undated, and the local Gallica rendition could not be matched against a retrieved native original. Geometry uses the current named outline and the vicar’s published first-hand architectural inventory.
